examples.title: Tracing Energy in a Radio
examples.problem: Explain the energy transformation in a battery-powered radio.
examples.explanation: The chemical energy stored in the battery is released to provide electrical current, which the speaker uses to vibrate and create sound.

examples.title: Potential to Kinetic
examples.problem: A ball is held at the top of a slide. What happens when it is released?
examples.explanation: Height gives it potential energy; movement down the slide converts it to kinetic energy.

examples.title: Solar Heating
examples.problem: How does a black box get hot in the sun?
examples.explanation: Dark surfaces absorb light energy and convert it into heat energy.
